title: Culturally-Nuanced Story Generation for Reasoning in Low-Resource Languages: The Case of Javanese and Sundanese

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a culturally grounded StoryCloze-style commonsense reasoning task in Javanese and Sundanese, and using human annotators to score the cultural relevance, fidelity, and plausibility of LLM-generated narratives.

Analyzing the lexical diversity of LLM-generated texts by measuring the proportion of foreign loanwords and the lack of deep sociolinguistic features (e.g., honorific variations) to assess the models' reliance on dominant, high-resource languages.
